name: School: First Period
description: Local studies: one roll to name the founders, one to learn the city. Not rolling is free.

outcomes.criticalSuccess: They name all four, and add that Rupiah still cuts the ribbon on Founding Day. The teacher is delighted.
outcomes.success: They name all four: Hyuck, Rupiah, Anabala, Shucks Mordant. The teacher writes them on the board.
outcomes.failure: They get two. The teacher fills in the rest, kindly.
outcomes.criticalFailure: They name a famous general instead. The teacher corrects them, and the room laughs, not unkindly.

outcomes.criticalSuccess: The teacher hands over his own tram map, twenty years of pencil notes on which services actually run. Grant it.
outcomes.success: They can find their way across the city this afternoon, and they know which tram to take.
outcomes.failure: Kept back to copy the map: they're last into the stores, and the handlamps have sold out.
outcomes.criticalFailure: Kept back through the break and late for everything after: Fatigued tonight.

bySkill.society: The districts by who lives in them: the old families on the waterfront, the newcomers' streets further in.
bySkill.survival: The city by its water: the river, the outfalls, and which streets flood first.
bySkill.perception: The seaward edge of the map is newer than the rest, drawn in a different hand.

notes: The whole section sits this lesson. The founders' names come out on any result. Anyone may work at the map, so learning the city can be rolled once by each player.
